questions.question: What is card spend this month?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS card_spend
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'

questions.question: Card spend by branch last month
questions.sql:
SELECT b.name AS "branch",
       SUM(t.amount) AS card_spend
FROM transactions t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY b.name
ORDER BY card_spend DESC

questions.question: How many new customers joined this year?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM customers c
WHERE c.joined_date >= '2026-01-01' AND c.joined_date < '2026-10-22'

questions.question: What's the NPL ratio?
questions.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_past_due > 90 THEN s.outstanding ELSE 0 END) / SUM(s.outstanding) AS npl_ratio
FROM loan_snapshots s JOIN loans l ON l.loan_id = s.loan_id
WHERE s.snapshot_date = '2026-10-21'

questions.question: NPL ratio by region
questions.sql:
SELECT b.region AS "region",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_past_due > 90 THEN s.outstanding ELSE 0 END) / SUM(s.outstanding) AS npl_ratio
FROM loan_snapshots s JOIN loans l ON l.loan_id = s.loan_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id
WHERE s.snapshot_date = '2026-10-21'
GROUP BY b.region
ORDER BY npl_ratio DESC

questions.question: Show the loan book over time
questions.sql:
SELECT s.snapshot_date AS "date",
       SUM(s.outstanding) AS loan_book
FROM loan_snapshots s JOIN loans l ON l.loan_id = s.loan_id
WHERE s.snapshot_date >= '2024-11-01' AND s.snapshot_date < '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY s.snapshot_date
ORDER BY s.snapshot_date

questions.question: Card spend vs last month
questions.sql:
SELECT 'current' AS period,
       SUM(t.amount) AS card_spend
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'previous' AS period,
       SUM(t.amount) AS card_spend
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-09-21 14:40:00'

questions.question: Which branch has the most ATM withdrawals?
questions.sql:
SELECT b.name AS "branch",
       COUNT(*) AS atm_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id
WHERE t.type = 'ATM withdrawal'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
GROUP BY b.name
ORDER BY atm_count DESC

questions.question: Net inflow by month
questions.sql:
SELECT substr(t.ts, 1, 7) AS "month",
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.direction = 'in' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS net_flow
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
GROUP BY substr(t.ts, 1, 7)
ORDER BY substr(t.ts, 1, 7)

questions.question: Total deposits by segment
questions.sql:
SELECT c.segment AS "segment",
       SUM(s.balance) AS total_deposits
FROM balance_snapshots s JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
WHERE s.snapshot_date = '2026-10-21'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY total_deposits DESC

questions.question: How many card payments today?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_payments
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-21 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'

questions.question: Card spend today by hour
questions.sql:
SELECT substr(t.ts, 12, 2) || ':00' AS "hour",
       SUM(t.amount) AS card_spend
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-21 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
GROUP BY substr(t.ts, 12, 2) || ':00'
ORDER BY substr(t.ts, 12, 2) || ':00'

questions.question: Late payments on personal loans by region
questions.sql:
SELECT b.region AS "region",
       100.0 * AVG(s.days_past_due > 30) AS late_rate
FROM loan_snapshots s JOIN loans l ON l.loan_id = s.loan_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id
WHERE s.snapshot_date = '2026-10-21'
  AND l.product = 'Personal loan'
GROUP BY b.region
ORDER BY late_rate DESC

questions.question: Average interest rate on mortgages by quarter
questions.sql:
SELECT substr(l.issued_date, 1, 4) || '-Q' || ((CAST(substr(l.issued_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS "quarter",
       AVG(l.interest_rate) AS avg_rate_new
FROM loans l
WHERE l.issued_date >= '2024-11-01' AND l.issued_date < '2026-10-22'
  AND l.product = 'Mortgage'
GROUP BY substr(l.issued_date, 1, 4) || '-Q' || ((CAST(substr(l.issued_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3)
ORDER BY substr(l.issued_date, 1, 4) || '-Q' || ((CAST(substr(l.issued_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3)

questions.question: Digital share of transfers by age band this year
questions.sql:
SELECT c.age_band AS "age band",
       100.0 * SUM(t.channel IN ('App', 'Web')) / COUNT(*) AS digital_share
FROM transactions t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.type = 'Transfer out'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
GROUP BY c.age_band
ORDER BY digital_share DESC

questions.question: What share of transfers are done in the app by region?
questions.sql:
SELECT b.region AS "region",
       100.0 * SUM(t.channel IN ('App', 'Web')) / COUNT(*) AS digital_share
FROM transactions t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id
WHERE t.type = 'Transfer out'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
GROUP BY b.region
ORDER BY digital_share DESC

questions.question: Top 3 merchant categories by card spend in August
questions.sql:
SELECT t.merchant_category AS "merchant category",
       SUM(t.amount) AS card_spend
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY t.merchant_category
ORDER BY card_spend DESC
LIMIT 3

questions.question: Fee income year on year
questions.sql:
SELECT 'current' AS period,
       SUM(t.amount) AS fee_income
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Fee'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'previous' AS period,
       SUM(t.amount) AS fee_income
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Fee'
  AND t.ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2025-10-21 14:40:00'

questions.question: How many customers do we have?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM balance_snapshots s JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE a.product = 'Current account'
  AND s.snapshot_date = '2026-10-21'

questions.question: Active app users last week
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS app_users
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.channel = 'App'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-12 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-19 00:00:00'

questions.question: New lending in Q2 2026 by loan type
questions.sql:
SELECT l.product AS "loan type",
       SUM(l.principal) AS loans_issued
FROM loans l
WHERE l.issued_date >= '2026-04-01' AND l.issued_date < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY l.product
ORDER BY loans_issued DESC

questions.question: How much cash was withdrawn at ATMs in Faro yesterday?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS atm_cash
FROM transactions t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id
WHERE t.type = 'ATM withdrawal'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-10-20 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
  AND b.city = 'Faro'

questions.question: Salaries received since March
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS salaries_in
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type IN ('Salary', 'Pension')
  AND t.ts >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'

questions.question: Customers lost by month this year
questions.sql:
SELECT substr(c.closed_date, 1, 7) AS "month",
       COUNT(*) AS customers_lost
FROM customers c
WHERE c.closed_date >= '2026-01-01' AND c.closed_date < '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY substr(c.closed_date, 1, 7)
ORDER BY substr(c.closed_date, 1, 7)

questions.question: Active customers in the last 30 days
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS active_customers
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.channel <> 'Automatic'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-09-21 14:40:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'

questions.question: Average balance of savings accounts
questions.sql:
SELECT AVG(s.balance) AS avg_balance
FROM balance_snapshots s JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.snapshot_date = '2026-10-21'
  AND a.product = 'Savings account'

questions.question: Total deposits in the Algarve vs last year

FROM balance_snapshots s JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id

JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id
WHERE s.snapshot_date = '2026-10-21'

questions.question: Loans issued this year vs last year

       SUM(l.principal) AS loans_issued
FROM loans l
WHERE l.issued_date >= '2026-01-01' AND l.issued_date < '2026-10-22'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'previous' AS period,

questions.question: Card spend by category and segment last month
questions.sql:
SELECT t.merchant_category AS "merchant category",
       c.segment AS "segment",
       SUM(t.amount) AS card_spend
FROM transactions t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY t.merchant_category, c.segment
ORDER BY card_spend DESC

questions.question: Weekly card payments
questions.sql:
SELECT date(t.ts, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS "week starting",
       COUNT(*) AS card_payments
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Card payment'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-08-03 00:00:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
GROUP BY date(t.ts, 'weekday 0', '-6 days')
ORDER BY date(t.ts, 'weekday 0', '-6 days')

questions.question: Daily transfers out in the last 30 days
questions.sql:
SELECT substr(t.ts, 1, 10) AS "day",
       SUM(t.amount) AS transfers_out
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.type = 'Transfer out'
  AND t.ts >= '2026-09-21 14:40:00' AND t.ts < '2026-10-21 14:40:00'
GROUP BY substr(t.ts, 1, 10)
ORDER BY substr(t.ts, 1, 10)

questions.question: Interest rates on new loans this year by loan type

       SUM(t.amount) AS atm_cash
FROM transactions t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
